{{EventEnd|date = 26th of January 2022}} {{For|[[Eclipsed (Hexscape)]]|[[Eclipsed (Nil Zone)]]}} {{EventInfobox |title1 = Solar Eclipse Event |image1 = SolarEclipseThumbnail2.png |dates = 4 December 2021 – 26 January 2022 |acts = 4 |act_name = Nights |tracks = 1 |previous_event = [[Frost Invasion Event|Frost Invasion]] |next_event = [[Duck Hunt Event|Duck Hunt]] |previous_pass = [[Frost Invasion Event#Frost Invasion Season|Frost Invasion]] |next_pass = [[Season of Love]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Solar Eclipse Event''' was the ninth event to be added to Tower Defense Simulator. This event added one new event tower, the [[Executioner]]. It also had a season pass, which required {{SolarShard|Solar Shards}} to reach higher ranks. This event was unique due to its night system. There were a total of four different nights with unique enemies, with each night getting harder. Each night was theoretically meant to release 48 hours after each other, with Night 1 releasing six hours after the event was released. However, due to changes in timing to better adapt to playing audiences, some nights came out before and after this 48 hour time period. You could not play subsequent nights without triumphing all those prior. Triumphing Night 4 would reward the [[Executioner]]. This event started on the 4th of December 2021 at [[wp:Coordinated Universal Time|19:00 UTC]], and concluded on the 26th of January 2022 at [[wp:Coordinated Universal Time|02:00 UTC]]. ==Solar Eclipse Season Pass== [[File:Season.png|center|500px|thumb]] You could have obtained {{SolarShard|Solar Shards}} from playing any night. You could also obtain {{SolarShard|Solar Shards}} from playing non-event matches. seven total major bosses were used. *This was the first event to have a campaign mechanic whereby completing one map unlocks another to complete. **The [[Lunar Overture Event]], the [[Hexscape Event]] and the [[Null & Void Event]] use the same mechanic from this event, where acts or nights release overtime. **Originally, the [[Violent Night Event]] was also going to share this mechanic. **The [[The Classic Event]] and [[The Takeover Event]] use the same mechanic, however each map or difficulty released at the same time. *This was the first event to default to [[Matchmaking]] for starting matches instead of [[Elevators]], followed by the [[Duck Hunt Event]], though [[Elevators]] remained the default method of starting matches in other modes. *This was the first event to utilize multiple maps included to it; four total maps were used. *This was the first event to use interactable objects, specifically the [[Star Cannon]] and [[Charge (Item)|Charge]]. *This was the second event to have event currencies gained outside of the event, the first being the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. *The '''Solar Eclipse Event''' was released on the same day that a [[wp:Solar eclipse of December 4, 2021|total solar eclipse happened in real life]]. **However, totality could only be seen from Antarctica. **This event was originally branded as the ''Halloween 2021 Event'', but due to the Roblox website being inoperable for 73 hours between the 28th of October 2021 and the 31st of October 2021, the event was postponed and was released on the same day of a total solar eclipse. *Razuatix at one point stated that unclaimed skins from this season would be converted into a crate at some point after the '''Solar Eclipse Event''' ended, but this never happened.[[File:SolarEclipseCrateProof.png|280px]]
https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/664903629546717218/935146713176485918 (Tower Defense Simulator Discord Server) *Few weeks after the event has ended, all players with the [[Executioner]] received an {{Color|Eclipse|Eclipse}} skin for free. ==Notes== {{EventNavBox}} [[Category:Passes]]
